notes.text: Alliance Psychiatric Group: Declined, as it is a facility rather than an insurance plan or provider network.
Far Northern Regional Center: Declined, as it is an agency that serves individuals with developmental disabilities rather than a health plan or provider network.
Evernorth Behavioral Health (Cigna): Excluded, as APA is already covered/in network
Golden Physicians Medical Group: Excluded, as APA is already in network.

Foothill Accountable Care Medical Group, Inc. (ACO): Declined, as we were unable to locate sufficient or reliable information regarding the organization online, and the contact information listed in the directory appears to be incorrect.
California Health Advocates: Declined, as it is an advocacy and education organization rather than a health plan or provider network.

Inter Valley Health Plan, Inc.: Declined, as the organization is in the process of winding down operations. It was a federally qualified HMO providing medical services to eligible Medicare participants.
Integrative Rheumatology / Institute for Specialized Medicine: Declined, as its website states that the practice is permanently closed and directs patients to another rheumatology practice.

ASPIRE HEALTH MSO LLC: Declined, as it provides non-clinical administrative and management services to healthcare providers and clinics, including billing, regulatory compliance, technology, and scheduling, rather than operating as a health insurance payer or provider network.

Foundation for Medical Care of Kern County MPN: Submitted a network participation request for APA to become a participating behavioral health provider, highlighting APA’s California-wide behavioral health capabilities and requesting information regarding MPN participation, contracting, credentialing, telehealth, reimbursement, and provider enrollment requirements.

Global Care Medical Group IPA, Inc.: Submitted a network participation request, highlighting APA’s Los Angeles County locations in Encino, West Covina, and Long Beach, along with statewide telehealth capabilities. Requested information regarding contracting, credentialing, service-area eligibility, reimbursement, and participation requirements.

Golden Empire Transit District: Submitted a request to become a participating behavioral health provider and requested information regarding the applicable health plan/network arrangement, contracting, credentialing, service area, telehealth, and reimbursement requirements.

Innovative Integrated Health (IIH): Submitted a network participation request for APA, highlighting APA’s Fresno and Irvine locations within IIH’s service area, along with statewide telehealth capabilities and comprehensive behavioral health services. Requested information regarding contracting, credentialing, provider enrollment, service-area eligibility, telehealth participation, reimbursement, and requirements for behavioral health providers serving PACE participants.

IYAR CARE LLC: Submitted a provider participation inquiry on behalf of APA, highlighting APA’s over 70 providers across 35 locations throughout California, statewide in-person and telehealth behavioral health services, and requesting information regarding IYAR CARE’s network/contracting structure, service area, credentialing, provider enrollment, reimbursement, telehealth, and participation requirements.

Lodestar MPN: Submitted a network participation request for APA to become a participating behavioral health provider, highlighting APA’s over 70 providers across 35 locations throughout California, including relevant locations in Folsom, Roseville, Sacramento, Elk Grove, Auburn, Fresno, Chico, Fremont, San Rafael, Rancho Cucamonga, West Covina, Long Beach, Irvine, Encino, and Santa Barbara, along with statewide telehealth capabilities. Requested information regarding MPN participation, contracting, credentialing, injured-worker requirements, telehealth, reimbursement, and provider enrollment.
Omaha National Underwriters, LLC: Submitted a request to contract with the organization through its website.

PRIME Plus MPN Powered by Harbor Health Systems: Submitted a network participation request on behalf of APA to join the PRIME Plus MPN as a behavioral health provider, highlighting APA’s over 70 providers across 35 locations throughout California and statewide in-person and telehealth capabilities. Requested information regarding MPN participation, contracting, credentialing, provider enrollment, service-area eligibility, telehealth, reimbursement, and workers’ compensation behavioral health requirements.
Grow Therapy: Submitted a request to join through the provider portal.

Health Net: Prepared a follow-up email to Erika regarding our request to add all APA locations and providers to the Health Net provider directory. Confirmed that we submitted the roster requested by Health Net with all required information and are still awaiting a response.
PromiseCare: Updated the status on the tracking sheet to reflect that they are not interested at this time.
Created a detailed report covering all new providers who joined APA during the last three months.
Sent Carl a reminder regarding his upcoming training.
